description: What devpit's own webviews are allowed to reach. `core:default` does not grant the window controls a frameless titlebar needs, so they are named explicitly. Scoped by WEBVIEW and not by window: tauri enables a window-scoped capability on every webview in that window regardless of this list (tauri-utils/src/acl/capability.rs:150-157), so once this window holds a browser webview, `windows: [main]` would hand devpit's whole command surface to whatever page is loaded in it. Both labels here are exact and neither is a pattern: a browser pane is `devpit-browser:<pane>` and nothing in this list can match it. `xtask/src/packaging.rs` refuses a capability that breaks either rule.
